title: Indriya
text: 2 Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || Indriyasampanno indriyasampanno ti vuccati || kittāvatā nu kho bhante indriyasampanno hotīti || || 4 Cakkhundriye ce bhikkhu udayavyayānupassī viharanto cakkhundriye nibbindati || Sotindriye || Ghānindriye || Jivhindriye || Kāyindriye || Manindriye ce bhikkhu udayavyayānupassī viharanto manindriye nibbindati || nibbindaṃ virajjati || la || Vimutasmi vimuttamhīti ñānaṃ hoti || Khīnā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ || kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāti || || 5 Ettāvatā kho bhikkhu indriyasampannoti || || [page 141] XXXV. 154. 9] NAVAPURĀṆAVAGGO PAÑCAMO 141
